description: This file defines a ServerRegistry class for managing browser descriptors, including listing, creating, deleting, and finding browser entries, as well as utility functions for connection checks and directory paths. It is part of the Playwright core server infrastructure.

classes.name: ServerRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser descriptor files, including listing, creating, deleting, and reading descriptors, and checking connection status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Reads browser descriptor files, checks connection status, and returns a map of workspace directories to browser statuses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new browser descriptor file with provided browser info and endpoint details.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a browser descriptor file by GUID.

methods.name: deleteUserData
methods.description: Deletes user data directory associated with a browser descriptor.

methods.name: readDescriptor
methods.description: Reads and parses a browser descriptor file by GUID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a browser descriptor by its title.

methods.name: _browsersDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where browser descriptor files are stored.
